predictions.selection_reason: Inserts a hidden field with the device's user ID into the delete form, which is later used in the success URL without validation, enabling potential tampering.
predictions.source_summary: The user_id value comes from object.user.id in the template context, representing the device owner's ID
predictions.sink_summary: The user_id POST parameter is used directly in DeviceDeleteView.get_success_url() to construct a redirect URL without validation
predictions.guard_summary: No validation of the user_id parameter in get_success_url(); uses self.request.POST.get('user_id') directly
predictions.risk_pattern: Hidden form field value flows directly into URL construction without validation, enabling potential redirect manipulation
predictions.context_summary: Template inserts hidden user_id field in device deletion confirmation form; the view uses this POST parameter to construct redirect URL
